row.team_price_text: Agentic HRIS Foundation: $7/employee/mo list (€7; $0 promo with any Talent Suite module until Dec 31)
row.evidence: Leapsome documents a SCIM API (token under Settings > Integrations and imports > HRIS integrations) used by Okta and Entra ID, but its pricing page (Agentic HRIS Foundation/Pro plus modules) never says which plan includes SCIM; it lists "Integrations" and "SSO & encryption" as always included.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to unknown. Pricing was restructured: an Agentic HRIS platform (Foundation €7/$7, Pro €10/$10 per employee/month; Foundation $0 with any Talent Suite module until Dec 31, US Pro promo $5) plus per-module add-ons (Performance Reviews €7, Recruiting €5, Goals €4, Surveys €4, Learning €4, Compensation €3, Time Tracking €3). The June Enterprise tier and the volume-tiered $3-7 pricing no longer appear, and no first-party page now ties SCIM to Enterprise or any other plan, so the June scim_plan "Enterprise" and "requires SSO" were dropped. The page shows the same numbers in EUR, USD and GBP (calculator rate 1). SCIM: https://www.leapsome.com/api/scim, bearer SCIM token, deactivation (not deletion) keeps data and does not reduce billed licences. Content API is read-only. Category: HR.

plans.price_text: €7/$7 per employee/month list; €0 with any Talent Suite module until Dec 31

plans.name: Agentic HRIS Pro
plans.price_text: €10/$10 per employee/month (US launch offer $5 until Dec 31)
plans.notes: Adds "Advanced integrations". Talent Suite modules priced per employee on top of either platform tier.

scim.notes: Version inferred from the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0 namespaces in the Okta guide.

auth.token_source: Settings > Integrations and imports > HRIS integrations > SCIM (Azure AD, Okta, ...) > SCIM Authentication Token

endpoints.notes: Full SCIM reference is in-app only.

operations.notes: read: Okta can import Leapsome users into Okta.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users' data (feedback, reviews, survey answers) stays in Leapsome; deactivation removes them from open review cycles and archives personal goals.

custom.how: Create the custom attribute in Leapsome, then send it under the enterprise extension namespace using the Leapsome custom attribute ID as the external name.

attributes.notes: Leapsome lists fields by label (First/Last Name, Position, Department, Manager, Additional Managers, Level, Division, Cost center, Location, Gender, Start/End Date, Birthday, Photo, custom). SCIM names listed come from the Okta guide (and userName from the Entra connector limits); First/Last Name, Position, Division, Gender and Photo mapping names are given by label only.

limitations.text: Leapsome advises against the Entra gallery app and recommends a custom non-gallery app for advanced customisations.
Entra ID cannot provision null attributes, so cleared values in Entra are not cleared in Leapsome.
Two full syncs are recommended: the first creates users, the second sets reporting lines and managers.
userName must be unique and only work email addresses are accepted (Entra connector).
Unassigning the Okta app without first disabling de-provisioning deactivates every user, which can cause irreversible data loss in ongoing processes.

auth.notes: Separate Content API secret created in Settings; not the SCIM token.

capabilities.notes: Content API is read-only (extract employee, review, goal, payroll and time-tracking data); provisioning must use SCIM.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Leapsome workflows can push user changes to Entra ID (outbound HRIS-to-IdP provisioning via partner Kombo).

limitations.text: Content API cannot change data in Leapsome.

okta.notes: OIN markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked.

onelogin.notes: Leapsome has an "SSO with OneLogin" help article; no OneLogin provisioning guide found.

jumpcloud.notes: Leapsome integration page says JumpCloud syncs users; JumpCloud's own page not checked (blocks bots); mechanism not stated.

fallbacks.other_sync: Native HRIS integrations (Personio, BambooHR, HiBob, Rippling, ADP, etc.) and SFTP/manual user file upload
fallbacks.notes: JIT depends on the IdP (e.g. Azure AD). SCIM and Content API references are only reachable inside the Leapsome app; help-centre guides are public.

searched: help-centre search API (help.leapsome.com): scim, sso, api, okta, entra, deactivate, advanced integrations, SCIM plan, pricing
open_questions: Which plan (Foundation, Pro, any module) includes SCIM: not stated on the pricing page or in help articles; the June "Enterprise" gate has no current first-party source.
Whether SCIM requires SSO to be configured first.
SCIM filtering, pagination, PUT vs PATCH support and rate limits are only in the in-app API docs.
Whether SCIM DELETE deletes or deactivates users.
Billing period (annual vs monthly) for the per-employee prices is not stated on the pricing cards.
OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue provisioning not verified on the IdP sites.
